Act14-1#1.zh: 我们给了官军迎头一击，他们大概暂时不敢再追来了。
Act14-1#1.t: We gave the army a crushing blow. They probably won't dare come after us for a while.

Act14-1#2.zh: 何涛这家伙也不看看对手是谁！还想黑吃黑，先除掉我们，再吞了生辰纲；结果陪上自己一条命，活该。
Act14-1#2.t: That He Tao didn't even look at who he was up against! Trying to rob the robbers, get rid of us first and then swallow the birthday gifts. He paid with his own life. Served him right.

Act14-1#3.zh: 可恶！可恶！为什么我会那么倒霉！好死不死遇上了这种贪官污吏，明明是为民除害却变成了袭击政府官军，现在我真的是跳到黄河也洗不清了！
Act14-1#3.t: Damn it! Damn it! Why am I so unlucky! Of all people I ran into that corrupt official. I was ridding the people of a pest, and it turned into attacking the government's army. Now even the Yellow River couldn't wash me clean!

Act14-1#5.zh: 是啊！要是没有遇上你们来抢『生辰纲』，我也不会错失将功赎罪的机会！也还是有机会在梁中书手下当一名官吏！这样也不会做出这种有辱家门的事了！
Act14-1#5.t: Yes! If I hadn't run into you lot stealing the 'birthday gifts', I wouldn't have lost my chance to atone! I could still have been an officer under Secretary Liang! And I wouldn't have done something that disgraces my family!

Act14-1#7.zh: 都是你！你害我怎么去见杨氏的列祖列宗？！
Act14-1#7.t: It's all your fault! How can I face the ancestors of the Yang family now?!

Act14-1#8.zh: 不要天真了！就算生辰纲没事，你可以继续当梁中书的走狗；这样子你就满足了吗？！
Act14-1#8.t: Don't be naive! Even if the birthday gifts were safe, you'd go on being Secretary Liang's lapdog. Would that satisfy you?!

Act14-1#10.zh: 『不怕官，只怕管。』在那种官僚下做事，叫你去奸淫掳掠，可以加上冠冕堂皇的理由；如果你良心不安想提出抗议，他就以你的亲人身家财产做威胁！没错，只要乖乖听话，想要衣食无虞是没有问题；但是，你的良知会心安吗？！你的列祖列宗会为你的行为骄傲吗？！
Act14-1#10.t: 'Fear not the official, fear the one who manages you.' Working under officials like that, they'll send you to rape and plunder and dress it up with grand excuses. If your conscience troubles you and you protest, they threaten your family and property! True, if you obey you'll want for nothing. But will your conscience be at peace?! Would your ancestors be proud of what you've done?!

Act14-1#12.zh: 还有，世界上并不是只有你一个人不幸！不幸的好人总是比幸福的恶人多；而且恶人的幸福都是建筑在好人的血肉上！
Act14-1#12.t: And you're not the only unlucky man in the world! Unlucky good men always outnumber lucky bad ones, and the bad ones' luck is built on the good ones' flesh and blood!

Act14-1#13.zh: 只要...只要世上还有贪官污吏、地痞恶霸、被欺压的善良百姓就只有受苦的份...我学得这身武功，并不是要当别人的走狗！我能够替其他被欺压的人出些力吗...
Act14-1#13.t: As long as... as long as there are corrupt officials and local bullies, good common folk will only suffer... I didn't learn my martial arts to be someone's lapdog! Can I do something for others who are oppressed...?

Act14-1#14.zh: 林冲原本是八十万禁军教头；高俅的儿子看上他的妻子，高俅就设圈套陷害他...他也身受污吏之害，不得不落草...
Act14-1#14.t: Lin Chong was an instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards. Gao Qiu's son set his eyes on his wife, so Gao Qiu framed him... He too suffered at corrupt officials' hands and had to become an outlaw...

Act14-1#15.zh: 俺则是看不过意一个地方土霸强收民女为妾，三拳把那家伙打死了...所以就只有出家当和尚...
Act14-1#15.t: As for me, I couldn't stand a local tyrant forcing a common girl to be his concubine, and killed him with three punches... So all I could do was become a monk...

Act14-1#16.zh: 你呢？你以前不也是有遇过这种地痞恶霸？当你自卫而杀了他，四周的人把你当作是为民除害，还帮你说情？
Act14-1#16.t: And you? Didn't you run into a thug like that before? When you killed him in self-defence, didn't the people around see it as ridding them of a pest and plead for you?

Act14-1#17.zh: ...我要自己一个人静一下，好好想想...
Act14-1#17.t: ...I need to be alone for a while and think it over...

Act14-1#18.t: Do you think he'll come back?

Act14-1#19.zh: 我不知道...这全由他自己决定...
Act14-1#19.t: I don't know... that's for him to decide...

Act14-1#20.zh: 话说回来，现在这一带官府一定四处发布我们的通缉令；晁兄，今后你有什么计划？
Act14-1#20.t: Anyway, the officials around here must be posting warrants for us everywhere. Brother Chao, what are your plans now?

Act14-1#21.zh: 刚才朱仝放我们逃走时，曾经提到『只有梁山泊才是安全的栖身地』；听说这一阵子的确有强盗在梁山扎寨。吴学究，我想暂时投靠到梁山，你觉得如何？
Act14-1#21.t: When Zhu Tong let us go, he said 'only Liangshan Marsh is a safe refuge'. I hear there really are bandits encamped on Liangshan these days. Master Wu, I'm thinking of seeking refuge on Liangshan for now. What do you say?

Act14-1#22.zh: 梁山泊峻山百重、恶水千里；实在是个安身立命的好地方。不过为首的王伦听说只是个不及第的秀才，只怕没有雅量收容我们...
Act14-1#22.t: Liangshan Marsh has a hundred layers of steep mountains and a thousand li of treacherous water; it's truly a good place to settle. But I hear its leader Wang Lun is only a failed scholar. I fear he won't be big-hearted enough to take us in...

Act14-1#23.zh: 总之，不去梁山一趟是不会知道王伦是怎样的人。
Act14-1#23.t: Either way, we won't know what Wang Lun is like until we go to Liangshan.

Act14-1#24.zh: 上梁山...就这样决定了！我们走吧！
Act14-1#24.t: To Liangshan... it's decided! Let's go!

Act14-1#25.zh: 等一下！我也要一起去！现在一个人走很容易就被官军逮住...我先声明，我只是暂时落草而已；总有一天我会被朝廷招安！
Act14-1#25.t: Wait! I'm coming too! Alone, I'd be caught by the army in no time... But let me be clear: I'm only an outlaw for now. One day I'll accept the court's amnesty!

Act14-1#26.zh: ...不管怎么样，算是多了一个帮手吧...？
Act14-1#26.t: ...Whatever the case, that's one more helper, I suppose...?

Act14-1#27.t: The heroes head up Liangshan together.
